status: PROPOSED NEXT CP1 ONLY; no implementation, test, candidate run or input resubmission authorized by this investigation
protocol: One coordinated ordinary-run input gate with target-side atomic acceptance, not a status-precheck fix followed by another speculative retry fix
execution_scope_if_approved: Exactly ONE fresh desktop original observed schedule after all deterministic host tests pass. No headless rerun, candidate/product/B2 rebuild, new guest controls, coverage/proof relaxation, alternate input route, deadline increase or further retry run.
source_prerequisite: RESOLVED at exact-package source level: installed1:8.2.2+ds-0ubuntu1.17 binary matches dpkg file checksum; exact Launchpad DSC/orig/debian checksums match; all128 active patches audited, none change input/dispatch/main-loop files. ui/input.c145-147 rejects before150-174 validation/dispatch/sync. Rejected BATCH has zero accepted prefix; earlier batches of the command may already be accepted.
coordination: Retain the existing SAME per-QMP RLock/full request-reply ownership. Use it as the observer execution/input-admission gate too; no second independent mutex that permits input during a native/proof critical section.

Explicit phases are PAUSED_OR_STEPPING, ORDINARY_RESUME_PENDING_OR_RUNNING and TERMINAL. Enter paused phase under the gate before servicing _stopped/heap/stack/snapshot/native-step/proof/restoration work; keep GUI input out of that critical section. Trace queries remain reentrant on the same RLock.

The observer alone executes its ORIGINAL ordinary RSP resume, after all guards/restoration/proof are satisfied. Update a natural-resume epoch under the gate and notify pending input; never add a c, s, QMP cont or resume solely for input delivery.

Do not hold the gate across blocking wait_stop while the VM is ordinarily running, a GUI screen wait, condition wait, snapshot queue wait or thread join. Conditions release the RLock completely so the observer continues and can naturally resume. Terminal/error/900s expiry wakes and rejects all pending input.

A resume notification, RSP running flag, QMP RESUME event or query-status running observation is only readiness information, not atomic acceptance. The exact package emits RESUME before setting RUNNING, and an asynchronous hardware stop can race any external status check.

Only the input-send-event handler's matching structured return/error is the acceptance linearization point. At source level its noncoroutine main-loop handler checks run-state before dispatch under QEMU's main-loop/BQL context. A race to debug-stop is handled as a proved zero-delivery rejection, never assumed away by the host lock.
batch_state_machine: One pending batch for the original single GUI producer. Encode/freeze the complete original events array and routing fields once before first transmission; retain exact bytes, local batch ID, modifier/down-up order, caller/phase, first deadline and natural-resume epoch. Do not regenerate a line or prepend earlier accepted characters.

Journal every exact GUI request and structured reply before interpreting it, with monotonic timestamps and batch/attempt/epoch identity; retain raw bytes. Preserve cmd(name,**args) and the separate direct trace-query name argument behavior.

Attempt only while the observer ordinary-run gate is open, under the same full-transaction RLock. Fresh running observations/natural resume notifications may schedule an attempt but are never a proof that it will succeed.

A matched successful return commits that batch ONCE and unblocks the producer to issue the next original batch. It proves emulator acceptance, not guest consumption or workload completion; never resend a successful batch.

ONLY a matched structured GenericError with desc exactly VM not running, for this outstanding input-send-event and unchanged source-bound binary, permits RETAIN_UNACCEPTED. The package guard proves that no event from that batch was dispatched. Release all locks and defer until a fresh ordinary-run readiness observation or natural-resume opportunity, coordinating with the observer's owned debug-stop processing. Resubmit the identical immutable batch, not any accepted prefix.

If a stop races admission before the observer has classified its RSP reply, retain the rejected batch without sending another event until ownership/phase is established. Unexpected signal/state, missing ownership, proof/coverage drift or terminal observer error stops both sides.

EOF, socket timeout, malformed/lost response, transport failure, source drift, other QMP errors or ambiguous acceptance are TERMINAL with NO resubmission. Never parse a formatted StepFailed string as proof of non-delivery. No blanket error retries or key-release workaround.

proposed_explicit_bounds_requiring_CP1.deadline_rule: Use the minimum of existing5s QMP-call budget, remaining original caller budget and remaining original900s VM window. Establish this deadline once before gate acquisition; waiting, classification queries and every rejected attempt consume it. Do not reset socket/command budgets for another attempt.
proposed_explicit_bounds_requiring_CP1.readiness_wait: Condition/observer notifications plus bounded read-only status observation, never a tight input-send loop. At most one actual attempt per new readiness observation; max64 and the single5s deadline both apply. No additional guest execution is caused to create readiness.
proposed_explicit_bounds_requiring_CP1.on_exhaustion: Report exact unaccepted batch/attempt history and STOP. No second desktop run or automatic policy adjustment.
proposed_explicit_bounds_requiring_CP1.liveness_ceiling: Source proves safe non-delivery for rejected batches, not that a sufficiently long ordinary-run opportunity exists under these unchanged deadlines. The one authorized smoke may still honestly stop for admission timeout.

required_deterministic_tests_before_the_: Both QMP owners retain complete request/reply/event ownership and trace-name API across all gate phases and error/EOF/timeout unlock paths.
Running success commits exactly once; debug rejection dispatches zero of a multi-event modifier/down-up batch; paused-to-natural-resume deferral delivers that same byte-identical batch once.
Hardware stop AFTER running precheck but BEFORE input handling returns exact pre-dispatch rejection; no accepted prefix or duplicate appears on later success.
Success followed by lost/timeout/malformed reply is terminal and never resubmitted; all nonmatching errors are terminal. Earlier accepted command batches are never replayed.
No GUI input reaches native/proof/restoration critical sections; original recurring one-extra-per-proved-event semantics and every coverage/lifecycle/source/context guard remain intact.

Pending GUI wait releases the common RLock; observer can process stops, service snapshots and naturally resume. Ordinary wait_stop never holds the admission gate; terminal/cleanup wakes pending GUI work without deadlock.
Only original observer c/s sequence is issued; deferred input never forces a resume, drain, third native step, watch removal or alternate input mechanism.

One shared monotonic5s/caller/900s deadline and max64-attempt cap cover lock wait, readiness polls and all attempts; no budget reset or silent timeout extension. Test exhaustion and source/ownership/state drift.

Exercise every original GUI input form used by launch, typing, modifiers, mouse and Ctrl-C through this same state machine, not just the character that happened to fail. Preserve original screen/prompt/cancel/status and metric semantics.

headless_separate_ceiling.whole_run_counter_caveat: Includes native execution/snapshot handling and cannot be subtracted as pure pause from that command deadline.

Retained data do not prove guest Ctrl-C receipt or a genuine interrupt failure versus counterfactual10-unpaused-second success. Keep the actual partial result; no pause-excluded clock or headless rerun is included.
